controlGate.note: The label text differs by docs/sr1-decisions.md decision 2 (Segoe UI vs SF); a labelled checkbox keeps its box at the Mac position relative to the label (leading edge), and AppKit sets a labelled box 0.8 pt low, so y is allowed 2 px of play for the line-height difference between the fonts. The box itself must match exactly with edge-aa<=32.
